title: Investigate and remediate telemetry shard skew causing intermittent dashboard blackout and trace discontinuities
creator: Maya Patel
description: Multiple customers reported dashboards showing 0s or missing series during an incident window while traces showed gaps for the same request IDs. Investigation indicates a telemetry ingestion shard skew and TTL tombstoning behavior combined with a recent partition-hash change during runtime-1.34 rollout. This ticket tracks root cause analysis, emergency mitigation, and a permanent fix to prevent future partial dashboard blackouts and trace discontinuities.
acceptance_criteria: All affected dashboards show continuous series for the previously observed incident window after reingest or fallback query
Trace stitching for affected request IDs is restored end-to-end in Staging and Production replay
Hotfix deployed with metric-source fallback and shard-skew alerting enabled
Regression tests added to ingestion integration tests to assert shard boundary invariants
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger high-write workload against hosted inference route with skewed key distribution (use test harness sim-key-skew)
2) Observe ingestion worker assignment and partition watermarks via /debug/shard_status endpoint
3) Run dashboard queries for tenant A and compare series counts between metric-aggregator and raw-events index
4) Replay a set of request IDs and verify whether KV cache traces are stitched or show missing spans
mitigation: Rolled a temporary query fallback in the console that switches the dashboard panels to raw-events index when series count drops below threshold. Opened an emergency reingest job that replays raw batches from the retention archive for the affected timeframe. Notified impacted customers with ETA for full restoration.
proposed_fix: Fix ingestion rebalancer to honor shard lease TTL and partition hash compatibility during rolling upgrades; add a transactional commit step to avoid tombstone race between compaction and shard handoff. Backfill missing time ranges via controlled reingest and provide a permanent dashboard query fallback for critical panels.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge and feature-flag the ingestion rebalancer change (canary in staging)
2) Deploy to a single production region with increased telemetry sampling for 2 hours
3) Monitor shard skew metric and traces for 1 hour, then expand to all regions
4) Enable automated reingest run for any shard gap > 10m encountered during rollout
testing_plan: Unit tests for rebalancer lease/sticky assignment logic
Integration test that simulates partition-hash change mid-ingest and asserts no tombstones are produced
End-to-end staging replay of 24h of traffic with trace stitching verification
Add synthetic dashboard that asserts series continuity for critical tenant routes
monitoring_and_alerting: New alert: telemetry.shard_skew_seconds > 300 for any shard -> Severity P1 page
Add alerting for dashboard panel zero-series fallback activation
Instrument reingest job with progress and error metrics published to Console
